description: This PHP source file contains unit tests for the ResetPasswordService class within the OrangeHRM authentication plugin. It validates functionalities such as password reset request handling, email generation, URL validation, and user record operations.

classes.name: ResetPasswordServiceTest
classes.description: This class contains unit tests for the ResetPasswordService, validating its methods related to password reset functionality within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mock services, configures test environment, and populates test data before each test.

methods.name: testGetEmailService
methods.description: Tests that getEmailService returns an instance of EmailService.

methods.name: testResetPasswordDao
methods.description: Checks that getResetPasswordDao returns an instance of ResetPasswordDao.

methods.name: testHasPasswordResetRequestNotExpired
methods.description: Validates that hasPasswordResetRequestNotExpired correctly assesses expiry of reset requests.

methods.name: testExtractPasswordResetMetaData
methods.description: Verifies extraction of password reset metadata from reset codes.

methods.name: testGenerateEmailBody
methods.description: Tests email body generation with placeholders and recipient data.

methods.name: testSearchForUserRecord
methods.description: Checks user record search functionality by username.

methods.name: testSendPasswordResetCodeEmail
methods.description: Validates email sending process for password reset codes.

methods.name: testGeneratePasswordResetCode
methods.description: Tests password reset code generation and its embedded metadata.

methods.name: testSaveResetPassword
methods.description: Checks saving of reset password credentials.

methods.name: testLogPasswordResetRequest
methods.description: Validates logging of password reset requests.

methods.name: testValidateUrl
methods.description: Tests the URL validation method for reset links.

methods.name: testValidateUser
methods.description: Verifies user validation method based on user entities.
